_: Usage note per token, keyed by the CSS variable name without its leading dashes. Hand-maintained; build.mjs reports tokens that have no entry.
color-canvas: Page background: #fbfbfc light, one step off white so white cards still read; #0b0b0d dark. `body` paints it.
color-surface: Sub-regions and the sidebar; the recessed CardPanel inside a Card; popovers.
color-card: Cards (`.neu-card`), context-menu panels and toasts: one just-perceptible step above the canvas, bordered with `color-border`.
color-elevated: Overlays and raised surfaces (`.neu-overlay`, dialogs), hover fills on ghost and outline buttons, inline code in notes.
color-text-primary: Headings, card and dialog titles, input text. On canvas, surface, card and elevated: 17.6:1+ light, 15.5:1+ dark.
color-text-secondary: Default body copy (`body`), note prose, menu items, outline badges. 9.5:1+ on every surface in both themes.
color-text-muted: Descriptions, labels, ghost-button text, secondary badges. 6.8:1+ on every surface in both themes.
color-text-faint: Eyebrow section labels, placeholders, shortcut hints, timestamps. Light: 5.3:1 on surface, 5.7:1 on canvas. Dark: 5.3:1 on elevated, 6.4:1 on canvas.
color-accent: The one brand hue, for text, links, strokes, the focus ring and selected states. A filled control takes `color-accent-fill` instead. Light: 6.7:1 on canvas, 6.1:1 on surface. Dark: 7.6:1 on canvas, 6.3:1 on elevated; white text on it fails.
color-accent-hover: Hover colour of accent text and links. Light: 7.1:1 on surface. Dark: 7.6:1 on elevated.
color-accent-subtle: 9% (14% dark) accent tint: accent badge fill, toast action button, info toast medallion, the new-case card on hover. Accent text on it: 5.4:1 or more light, 5.2:1 or more dark.
color-border: Hairline on cards, menu separators, step connectors, note blockquote rule, outline badges. #d6d6dc light, #2a2a30 dark.
color-border-strong: Outline buttons, context-menu and toast panels, the CardPanel border, card hover border. #bdbdc6 light, #3a3a41 dark.
color-indigo-300: Raw palette step. Entity types, status indicators and one-offs only; prefer `color-accent` for UI.
color-indigo-400: Raw palette step. Entity types, status indicators and one-offs only.
color-indigo-500: Raw palette step. The hue behind the logo pulse keyframe.
color-amber-400: Raw palette step. Severity and integrity warnings.
color-amber-500: Raw palette step. The hue the warning status triple tints from.
color-emerald-500: Raw palette step. The hue the success status triple tints from.
color-red-500: Raw palette step. The hue the danger status triple tints from; the shadcn `destructive` bridge.
color-red-600: Raw palette step. Fill of the destructive Button (white text, 4.8:1).
color-teal-500: Raw palette step. Entity and status one-offs.
color-violet-500: Mention entity hue (Selector). Exists so a chip references a token rather than a hex literal.
color-pink-500: Mention entity hue (tag fallback). Exists so a chip references a token rather than a hex literal.
color-success-surface: Success status fill: the 10% step of the tinted triple (fill / line / foreground), never a solid fill. Success badge, success toast medallion.
color-success-line: Success status border: the 20% step of the triple.
color-success-fg: Success text and icon on `color-success-surface`. Light is #046c4e, darker than emerald-700 so 10-12px text clears 4.5:1 on its tint and on a hovered row over every light surface (5.2:1 and 5.1:1 on surface); dark is #4ec38e (7.4:1 on elevated).
color-danger-surface: Danger status fill (10% step). Danger badge, error toast medallion.
color-danger-fg: Danger text and icon on `color-danger-surface`; the `danger` context-menu item. 6.3:1 on canvas light, 7.4:1 dark.
color-warning-surface: Warning status fill (10% step). Warning badge, warning toast medallion.
color-warning-fg: Warning words, where a warning must be words; advisory words otherwise take `color-text-secondary`. 6.9:1 on canvas light, 9.4:1 dark.
color-hue-orange-fg: Categorical hue: the crypto case-type pill, orange in both themes. Light uses the 800 step because 700 landed at 4.28:1 on its tint over surface; 7:1 on canvas.
color-hue-sky-fg: Categorical hue: case-type pills and the NEW badge. 5.7:1 on canvas light, 8.5:1 dark.
color-hue-pink-fg: Categorical hue: case-type pills. 5.8:1 on canvas light, 7.1:1 dark.
color-member-1: Shared Case member hue for the first non-Owner member in member-add order; ranks wrap after 4, so the fifth takes it too. The Owner seen from a member's machine, and a pending join, take the next free hue. Chip fill at 15%, chip border at 30%, solid dot and text. This installation is always `color-accent` but still holds its rank. A revoked member keeps its rank, so no other member's hue moves; the members list shows its chip in `color-text-faint`, while the ledger and capture authors keep its hue.
color-member-2: Shared Case member hue for rank 2 (and 6). See `color-member-1`.
color-member-3: Shared Case member hue for rank 3 (and 7). See `color-member-1`.
color-member-4: Shared Case member hue for rank 4 (and 8). See `color-member-1`.
color-slate-100: Raw slate step, reserved for severity and entity colours.
color-background: shadcn bridge: `bg-background` (active tab fill). Alias of `color-canvas`.
color-foreground: shadcn bridge: `text-foreground`, the tab trigger text and line indicator. Alias of `color-text-primary`.
color-primary: shadcn bridge. Alias of `color-accent-fill`, so `bg-primary` takes white text like any filled control.
color-primary-foreground: Text on a filled control: white, 5.8:1 on the light `color-accent-fill` and 5.4:1 on the dark one.
color-muted: shadcn bridge: `bg-muted`, the default TabsList track. Alias of `color-surface`.
color-muted-foreground: shadcn bridge: TabsList text. Alias of `color-text-muted`.
color-accent-foreground: shadcn bridge: text on an accent fill.
color-destructive-foreground: shadcn bridge: text on a destructive fill.
color-input: Border of Input and Textarea at rest: `color-control`, 4.1:1 on canvas light. The border turns `color-accent` on focus.
color-ring: The keyboard focus ring: `:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid; outline-offset: 2px }` on every control that draws no ring of its own. Alias of `color-accent`.
shadow-card: Card at rest. Note `.neu-card` itself sets `box-shadow: none` and relies on its border.
shadow-card-hover: Card on hover; in practice the hover cue is the border turning `color-border-strong`.
shadow-overlay: Dialogs (`.neu-overlay`), the command palette and toasts: the one clearly raised step.
shadow-glow: The retired indigo glow. Resolves to none in both themes; keep it none.
shadow-btn: Default Button shadow. Resolves to none, which is why the button focus ring is an outline rather than a box-shadow ring.
d-itemy: Menu and list item vertical padding.
d-itemx: Menu and list item horizontal padding.
radius: The 6px ceiling: `rounded` and the Tailwind default. Cards, dialogs, toasts, the lg Button, tab lists.
radius-md: Buttons, inputs, textareas, context-menu panels, tab triggers, skeletons: the control radius.
radius-2xl: Aliases `radius` (6px) in the source: Card and DialogContent use `rounded-2xl` and land on 6px.
d-r: The density-aware radius slot. Declared once on :root as `var(--radius)`; no density step redeclares it.
color-accent-fill: Background of a filled control: the default Button and Badge, count badges, checked checkboxes, an on switch track. One per view. White on it: 5.8:1 light, 5.4:1 dark.
color-accent-fill-hover: Hover fill of a `color-accent-fill` control. White on it: 6.9:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.
color-control: Boundaries of inputs, search fields, checkboxes, radios, the switch track and icon-only outline buttons, and the nominal status dot. 3:1 or more on every surface, hovered or not: 3.8:1 on surface light, 3.8:1 on elevated dark. So far only `color-input` uses it.
color-hover: Hover, keyboard highlight and an open pill: an ink tint (6%) that shows on every surface in both themes, white cards included. No component uses it yet.
color-scrim: Behind a dialog: dims the page without blacking it out. No dialog uses it yet.
color-warning-mark: The advisory mark: a hollow ring, icon or bar. 3.7:1 on surface light, 7.8:1 on elevated dark. No component uses it yet.
color-hue-teal-fg: Categorical hue for Captures in the link map, which does not use it yet. 4.9:1 on surface light, 7.7:1 on elevated dark.
color-hue-violet-fg: Categorical hue for Selectors in the link map, held clear of the accent; the link map does not use it yet. 6.2:1 on surface light, 6.1:1 on elevated dark.
shadow-menu: Menus and popovers: a cool two-layer shadow in light, a deeper one in dark. No menu uses it yet.
